newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador government to unveil economic plan Friday.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador government to unveil economic plan Friday.

text.p: Ecuador's President Fabian Alarcon said Wednesday he will unveil his new government's economic plan on Friday.
"On Friday night I will announce the general outlines of our economic plan," Alarcon told journalists.
The president said the economic plan his interim government will put into action in the 18 months of its mandate has been fully drafted, but he would not give any details.
"The only thing I will say is that the government will make a great effort to reduce the fiscal deficit without a great social cost," he said.

Alarcon's government, which took office after Congress ousted former president Abdala Bucaram nearly three weeks ago, faces a budget deficit estimated by analysts at between five and seven percent of gross domestic product this year.
